execution_route: Standalone core.flight.cli worker attached to the resident session; no campaign, no scorer.
quality_read_gate: No task-quality read before the complete sealed manifest, the exact ordered 1,080 outputs, the native phase summary and the single successful complete official TRAIN score all exist. Neither closed v1 run -- SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-NCP-L1-ANCHOR-TRAIN-FOLD-A-V1 nor SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-NCP-L1-ANCHOR-TRAIN-FOLD-A-RECOVERY-V1 -- is ever scored or read, in whole or in part. The comparators are the sealed dual-store anchor score artifact (primary) and the released direct anchor score artifact (secondary); neither is ever re-flown or re-scored. The four-row smoke is structural only: contact counts, episode receipt fields, the policy's rendered blocks and its receipt rows, the per-request MODEL_REQUEST sha256 comparison against the sealed v1 recovery smoke, fit receipts and seal, with no answer, reference or quality interpretation.
finite_completion_clause: Rows whose terminal_disposition.reason is finite_completion are RETAINED and scored as delivered -- the latest delivery-eligible Solver draft, or an abstention with empty output when no Solver completed -- and are never filtered out of the paired read. Their count, their sample ids and the by-role / by-stage / by-finish-reason breakdown that analysis.native_episode_diagnostics emits as finite_stops are a MANDATORY diagnostic in the verdict. A high count is a finding about the role's output length on this base; it is reported, not repaired inside this cell.
resume_recovery_supported: Owner decision 22 of 2026-09-18: the one root-diagnosed recovery this flight is allowed takes the resume-recovery form -- its own experiment fragment with resume_from {attempt_id, trace_sha256}, the same run id, core.flight.resume replaying the predecessor trace model-free. The registered cap is run-cumulative and covers it.
